summary: The confirmed_not_located closure stands. All 47 saved files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all four computations reproduced. Independent searches found no author gene-level results for the registered Alisol B versus control contrast. The corrected proposal identifies which files had intake checksums, attributes the candidate study’s treatment to the article PDF, and records that PubMed and PMC dropped both accessions from their text queries. The proposal passed the repository validator.
openIssues: The authors’ tested genes, effects, P values and FDR remain unavailable in the reviewed sources. Author concordance remains unassessed.
GEO documents three profiles per arm but leaves the independence of culture preparations unresolved.
